name: veridelta
description: Compare two datasets on their primary keys under rules you declare, on a laptop, in CI, or inside a warehouse.

paragraphs: Veridelta compares two datasets on their primary keys and reports every row that differs under the rules you declare. Nothing is forgiven unless a rule says so, and the exit code tells CI whether the datasets match. Use it to verify a migration, a pipeline change, or a model's new evaluation run, on a laptop, in CI, or inside a warehouse.
Watch the 60-second demo: a port from IDL to Python must match one to one, every row differs, and only the real bug fails CI.
